1161: Mary Elizabeth Mastrantonio (born November 17, 1958) is an American actress and singer. 11401: John Woo Yu-Sen SBS (born September 22, 1946) is a Hong Kong film director and producer. His Hollywood films include Hard Target, Broken Arrow, Face/Off and Mission: Impossible 2.  He also created the comic series Seven Brothers, published by Virgin Comics.  Woo was described by Dave Kehr in The Observer in 2002 as "arguably the most influential director making movies today".
